# Convivia Work

> Tech-forward coworking space at 1485 Treat Blvd, Walnut Creek, CA 94597. Walkable to Pleasant Hill BART, half a mile from Highway 680, across the street from The Bay Club Walnut Creek. Built for founders, creatives, remote workers, and small teams.

Staff are onsite Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Pacific. Coworking members and above have 24/7 keyless access. All memberships are month to month.

## Plans and pricing
- Day Pass: $50/day. Standing desk with monitor, WiFi, kitchen and coffee, phone booths.
- Coworking Membership: $382/month. 24/7 access, conference room credits, community events.
- Dedicated Desk Membership: $450/month. Your own personalized desk plus lockable storage.
- Custom Team Suite: custom pricing. Private offices and suites for teams of 2–12.
- Mail Service for Members: $50/month. Business address and mail/package receiving.
- Mail Service for Non-Members: $99/month plus a one-time $25 setup fee.
- Mail forwarding: $25/month plus postage.

## Spaces
- Private offices and team suites, including a team suite with seven desks and two displays.
- Four conference rooms with 4K displays and video conferencing: The Stack, Executive Boardroom, Small Meeting Room, Stand Up Meeting Room.
- AV production studio with green screen, wood backdrop, cinema lighting, and acoustic treatment.
- Multigigabit internet with 5G failover.
